meta.title: Isaac Galvez Pavilion · Municipal sports hall in Vilanova i la Geltrú
meta.description: Municipal indoor sports hall on Ronda Ibèrica, 66, Vilanova i la Geltrú. Courts for basketball, handball, futsal and volleyball, plus space for training and fixtures. Enquiries: 938 14 34 50.
meta.ogAlt: Isaac Galvez Municipal Sports Pavilion, Vilanova i la Geltrú

hero.kicker: Ronda Ibèrica, 66 · Vilanova i la Geltrú
hero.title: The hall where half of Vilanova plays
hero.lede: A municipal indoor facility for basketball, handball, futsal and volleyball. Courts for training and match days, seating and step-free access. Home to the town's teams.

glance.label: The hall at a glance
glance.bookingValue: By phone, subject to court availability

facilities.title: What is inside the hall
facilities.lead: A covered main court with seating, built for both league competition and school or training use.

f1.name: Main court
f1.detail: Covered, with seating, for basketball, handball, futsal and volleyball.

f2.name: Changing rooms
f2.detail: Changing rooms and showers for teams and officials, opening off the court.

f3.name: Spectator seating
f3.detail: Seats for the public, with space reserved for wheelchair users.

f4.name: Step-free access
f4.detail: Accessible entrance and parking for people with reduced mobility.

f5.name: Training area
f5.detail: Space for warm-ups and training off the main court.

f6.name: Sports grounds
f6.detail: Part of a sports zone shared with other municipal facilities.

sports.title: What you can play
sports.lead: The hall hosts the local leagues and the town clubs' training sessions through the season.

s1.name: Basketball
s1.note: A regulation court for club and school matches and training.

s2.name: Handball
s2.note: One of the facility's regular disciplines.

s3.name: Futsal
s3.note: An indoor court for local leagues and training games.

s4.name: Volleyball
s4.note: Net and enough space for competition and practice.

s5.name: School sport
s5.note: PE sessions and activities during the school day.

s6.name: Competition
s6.note: Venue for official fixtures of the town's teams.

reviews.title: What people say
reviews.lead: Extracts from reviews published on Google by people who use the facility.

visit.title: Where it is and how to get in
visit.lead: On Ronda Ibèrica, 66, in the sports zone of Vilanova i la Geltrú. Call ahead if you want to confirm court availability.
